name: 2022 CHIPS Act subsidy → US foundry beneficiaries

events.headline: President signs CHIPS and Science Act
events.summary: Provides $52B in US semiconductor manufacturing subsidies and 25% investment tax credit.

name: 2023 export control → NVDA/AMD direct China risk

events.headline: Commerce tightens AI chip exports to China
events.summary: New rules block sales of advanced GPUs (H100, A100) and successor chips to PRC entities; targets 13 additional firms.

name: China tariffs raised → Apple supply-chain hit

events.headline: US imposes 25% tariff on Chinese consumer electronics imports
events.summary: Includes smartphones and laptops assembled in China; takes effect Q3.

name: IRA solar credits extended → ENPH/FSLR upside

events.headline: Treasury finalizes IRA solar manufacturing tax credits
events.summary: 45X production credits affirmed for US-made solar cells, modules, inverters; ramps through 2032.

name: EV tax credits expanded → Tesla beneficiary

events.headline: IRS expands EV tax credit eligibility under IRA Section 30D
events.summary: $7,500 credit applies to North American-assembled EVs with qualifying battery sourcing; doubles 2024 list.

name: FDA accelerated Alzheimer approval → BIIB positive

events.headline: FDA grants traditional approval to Alzheimer's therapy lecanemab
events.summary: Medicare coverage expected to follow; broadens patient access.

name: FDA black-box warning → Pfizer earnings risk

events.headline: FDA adds black-box warning to JAK inhibitor class for cardiovascular events
events.summary: Affects Pfizer's Xeljanz; revenue impact estimated $300M annual.

name: Big Tech antitrust verdict → Google search monopoly

events.headline: Federal judge rules Google maintained illegal search monopoly
events.summary: Ruling opens door to remedies including breakup of default-search deals; appeal expected.

events.headline: Congress passes 7% defense budget increase emphasizing Indo-Pacific
events.summary: $886B FY24 NDAA; missile defense and shipbuilding line items grow double-digit.

name: Strategic Petroleum Reserve release → XOM/CVX margin pressure

events.headline: Administration announces 50M barrel SPR release to suppress oil prices
events.summary: Coordinated with allies; aimed at moderating retail gasoline.

name: Fed rate cut signal → broad equity tailwind

events.headline: Fed projects two rate cuts in 2025, dot-plot shows easing path
events.summary: FOMC SEP signals 50bp of cuts in 2025; risk assets rally.

name: Bank capital rules tightened → JPM/BAC headwind

events.headline: Federal Reserve finalizes Basel III endgame capital rules
events.summary: Largest banks face 9% increase in required capital; phase-in over 3 years.
